script: [serious] 1945. Nazi Germany has fallen. And the United States starts quietly recruiting its scientists. The program was called Operation Paperclip, named for the paperclips officers attached to the files of the experts they wanted. More than sixteen hundred German scientists and engineers came to America. President Truman's order said to keep out committed Nazis. But some files were rewritten... to hide their pasts. The most famous recruit was Wernher von Braun. In Germany, he'd been an officer in the SS, and his V-2 rockets were built by prisoners from a concentration camp. In America, he led the team that built the Saturn V, the rocket that took humans to the Moon. Another Paperclip engineer, Arthur Rudolph, gave up his U.S. citizenship in 1984 rather than face prosecution. [whispers] The Moon rocket... was built, in part, by men whose pasts were rewritten to get them in. This is Dossier Decoded. Case file number nine. Which file should we open next?
